test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A man rows downstream 27 km and upstream 18 km, taking one hour each time. What is the speed of the current?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance downstream = 27 km

Distance upstream = 18 km

Time taken downstream = 1 hour

Time taken upstream = 1 hour

**Formula Used:**

Speed downstream = Distance downstream / Time downstream

Speed upstream = Distance upstream
